name: Singing Toilets Tower Defense [Update 1!]
desc:
Game Is Closed Down and Is Being Remade Into A Separate Game!

🏆Gather your most Powerful Towers! Fight against Powerful Toilets using your Towers, and achieve victory to different kinds of Maps!!🏆
⬆️Upgrade your units to buff their stats and change them visually.⬆️

Warning: This game is in Alpha Stage. Data Reset may be possible, a lot of tower change's, and a lot of bugs.
If you find a bug, you can report it to the Group Chat/Group Wall.

Join the Discord for Leaks about the game!
